fusions.name: Slick Venom
fusions.desc: A quick stab with a venom-slicked knife that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bank to Bank
fusions.desc: Springs up to 6 tiles onto the target and drives the knife in, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.3 times harder from the far end of that reach.

fusions.name: Sudden Spring
fusions.desc: Springs 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Lie in Wait
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
